name: DATETIME_FORMAT
description: Formats a timestamp as a string using the specified format pattern.

examples.title: Format as ISO date
examples.sql: SELECT DATETIME_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date_str FROM events

examples.title: Custom format
examples.sql: SELECT DATETIME_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as formatted FROM logs

notes: Elasticsearch 6.8: a BARE date column is not supported (the doc-value reaches the script as a JodaCompatibleZonedDateTime). Wrap it — DATETIME_FORMAT(CAST(col AS DATE), ...) or DATETIME_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC(col, DAY), ...) — or use Elasticsearch 7+. A literal or cast operand works on every release. See issue #371.
